title: Release Engineering - Meeting Notes 2026-11-03
content:
Attendees: Maya Singh (owner), Ethan Park, Lina Alvarez, Jason Wu, Priya Rao, Tom Becker (SRE - note), Claire Moss (Product, joined for rollout window).

Agenda:
- Quick status on active release trains (stable/beta/canary)
- Hotfix review and prioritization
- Change log highlights for 2026.11.1 train
- Rollout windows and regional considerations
- Open blockers & action items

Meeting notes:
1) Release train status
- 2026.11.1 (stable train) — target ship: 2026-11-05 02:00 UTC. Cut is scheduled after final smoke tests on 2026-11-04. Current blocker: intermittent e2e failure on large-batch path (RE-1824). Jason is owning the investigation; root cause looks like a race in batch-coalescer under high concurrency. Temporary mitigation proposal: increase batch timeout and enable conservative flush for affected routes. Action: Jason/Ethan to test mitigation in staging by EOD 2026-11-03.
- 2026.11.2 (canary) — rolling in eu-west-1. No regressions observed in latency SLA for first 24h. Telemetry shows a 2% increase in 95th percentile for long-context prompts; Lina will follow up with perf team to check kernel selection logic for sequence lengths > 4096.
- Beta train (dev-only) — contains experimental quantization changes from the applied-ml branch. Still flagged as internal; not part of public rollout.

2) Hotfixes
- HOTFIX-2026-11-02-01: Tokenization regression causing incorrect annotations for some multi-byte sequences. Hotfix PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/342 — deployed to prod region us-west-2 at 2026-11-02T18:10Z. Monitoring healthy; no rollback needed.
- HOTFIX-2026-11-03-01: Memory leak in request router under prolonged sustained write (observed in dedicated pools). Identified in RE-1841. Patch in review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/347. Priority: high. Owners: Ethan (patch) + Priya (canary verification). Target deploy: 2026-11-04 00:30 UTC.

3) Change log highlights for 2026.11.1
- Serving runtime: fix for batch-coalescer race (RE-1824) — mitigations and final fix TBD.
- Console: added route-level cost breakdown in the traces panel (UX request CR-768).
- Dedicated: autoscaler now supports burst-capacity holdback config (config flag: dedicated.burst.holdback).
- Observability: added token-level sampling control (helps reduce telemetry cost for high-volume customers).
- Security: KMS rotation docs updated for Private deployments.

4) Rollout windows & regional notes
- Primary rollout window: 2026-11-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Ops will run canaries for 30 minutes per region.
- Regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. APAC rollouts delayed pending infra capacity confirmation (Tom to confirm physical capacity by 2026-11-04 morning).
- Fallback policy: if increased 95th percentile > 20% or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10 minutes, auto-rollback engaged — fallback model variant: redwood-v1-small.

5) Postmortem / incidents review
- Reviewed incident RE-1810 (2026-10-29) — root cause: bad retry interaction with the new CDN edge TTL. Action items: add end-to-end test covering CDN TTL behavior (owner: Priya, due 2026-11-10) and add docs for recommended retry headers in SDK.

6) Open blockers
- RE-1824 batch-coalescer race still not fully resolved. Impact: prevents confident ship of 2026.11.1 if not fixed. Jason to escalate to infra-kernel team if a full fix isn't landed by 2026-11-04 12:00 UTC.
- Capacity confirmation for APAC (Tom)
- Hotfix PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/347 requires extra verification on dedicated pools (Priya to own canary).

7) Action items (owners / due dates)
- Jason/Ethan: validate batch timeout mitigation in staging, report results (due 2026-11-03 EOD)
- Priya: run canary for memory-leak hotfix in dedicated pools; report status (due 2026-11-04 03:00 UTC)
- Tom: confirm APAC capacity and post in #release-engineering (due 2026-11-04 09:00 UTC)
- Lina: follow up with perf/kernel team on 95p latency for long-context prompts (due 2026-11-06)
- Priya: create e2e test for CDN TTL/retry behavior (postmortem action) (due 2026-11-10)
- Maya: update release notes draft and change log (2026.11.1) and send to Product for review (due 2026-11-04)

Notes / Misc:
- We discussed temporarily disabling the experimental continuous-batching optimizer in canary if batch-coalescer mitigation is insufficient.
- Reminder: engineering on-call rotation updated (see Confluence page and roster). On-call for the weekend: Ethan (primary), Lina (secondary).

Next meeting: 2026-11-10 10:00 UTC — focus on ship readiness and post-deploy analysis for 2026.11.1.
summary: Weekly release engineering meeting covering 2026.11.1 train readiness, hotfixes (tokenization, memory leak), change-log bullets, rollout windows (2026-11-05), open blockers and action items.
